claim_summaries: Proved an energy-to-pairwise-commutator bound for positive selfadjoint tracial selfcompatible channels: ||[A,C]||_2 <= (2+sqrt(2))(sqrt(e_Phi(A))+sqrt(e_Phi(C))) for Hermitian contractions.
Averaging gives a dimension- and frame-size-independent squared commutator bound for any finite prior, linear in the prior-average Dirichlet energy.
The arbitrary-frame EB/variance lift remains open; existing fixed-tuple almost-commuting results have tuple-size-dependent constants and do not close the required gate.
